{{Top|leg}}
'''Gravitic restraints''' were a type of restraining device. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] equipped the ''[[Slave II]]'' with gravitic restraints and molecularly reinforced cell walls. While Fett's primary target was [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], the gravitic restraints were intended to hold his [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
